entry.title: Python: How to Encrypt and Decrypt with AES
entry.summary:
Introduction
Sometimes we need to keep data secret—like passwords, personal details, or private messages. AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) is a very popular way to do this. AES is a method of turning normal text into unreadable text (encryption) and then back to normal (decryption) using the same secret key (symmetric algorithm). When you need to protect sensitive information—such as passwords, financial data, or confidential messages—encryption is essential. Before you start: Install Python 3.7 or newer. Install the Python package cryptography by running: pip install cryptography
AES is a symmetric key algorithm, which means the same secret key is used for both encryption and decryption. Key sizes supported by AES: 128 bits 192 bits 256 bits (the strongest and what we use in this exa…
